title: Deshaun Watson to start Saturday vs. Bears; Shedeur Sanders gets QB1 duties vs. Bills

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Deshaun Watson to start Saturday vs. Bears; Shedeur Sanders gets QB1 duties vs. Bills
sources.description: Deshaun Watson got the nod to be Cleveland's QB1 in the preseason opener in Chicago. Next week, that role will go to Shedeur Sanders.
